name: Shiro to Kuro no Densetsu ~Shin Hyakki Hen~
original_name: 白と黒の伝説 ~真百鬼編~
source:
Black and white compete from the creation of the Universe.

One day a mysterious fire breaks out at a mental hospital. A newspaper reporter tries to uncover the source of the incident and encounters the destruction god "Hyakki" who unleashes havoc on the Earth bringing humanity on the brink of survival. Later reporter has fateful meetings with special people who help to organize rebellion against the fallen God.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
自宇宙诞生之初，黑与白便一直相互争斗。

某天，一家精神病院发生神秘火灾。一名报社记者试图查明事故起因，却遇到了带来灾祸、将人类逼至灭亡边缘的毁灭之神“百鬼”。后来，记者与一些命运注定会相遇的特殊之人相识，并协助组织起反抗堕落之神的行动。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
